name: Ferienhaus Neuegg
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny hillside in Ladis overlooking the historic Laudeck Castle and surrounding peaks, Ferienhaus Neuegg promises pure relaxation. Its contemporary apartments feature high-quality fittings and private balconies.

Lifts across the premier Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis holiday region are quickly accessible, delivering unforgettable alpine experiences year-round.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Neuegg in Ladis offers a sunny panoramic setting and modern holiday apartments near historic Laudeck Castle.
